channel.title: BiteKrakow

item.title: African Food in Krakow (2026): Ethiopian Injera, Nigerian Jollof and Where to Eat
item.description: Where to eat African food in Krakow: two Ethiopian restaurants serving on injera, a Nigerian kitchen built around jollof rice, and a shop for ingredients, with hours.

item.title: Krakow Restaurant Week 2026: Dates, Prices, Rules and How to Book
item.description: Krakow Restaurant Week, 7 Oct to 25 Nov 2026: three courses and a cocktail for 69.99 zl plus a 10.99 zl fee at 54 restaurants. Rules and booking.

item.title: Habit: Maro Kafaro Opens a Restaurant in a Krakow Palace
item.description: Habit, the new restaurant from chef Marek Rusiński (Maro Kafaro), opened on 24 October 2026 in the Ogiński Palace at ul. Piłsudskiego 4: Central European food, with bars, jazz and art upstairs.

item.title: Krakow Restaurant Week 2026: All 54 Restaurants by District and the 12 We Would Book
item.description: Krakow Restaurant Week 2026: all 54 restaurants by district with festival dishes and prices, the 12 we would book first and booking answers.

item.description: What to eat in Krakow and where: pierogi, żurek, obwarzanek, zapiekanka, oscypek and more, with the canteens, milk bars and dinner tables locals use.

item.title: Best Flat White in Krakow: 5 Cafes That Get It Right
item.description: The best flat white in Krakow: own-roastery cafes, single-origin beans and proper microfoam. Five specialty cafes tested across five neighborhoods.

item.title: The 10 Best Restaurants in Krakow (2026): A Local's Ranking
item.description: The best restaurants in Krakow across every cuisine: the two-Michelin-star Polish table, plus the best pizza, sushi, Georgian, Thai and Indian.

item.title: Best Breakfast in Krakow: 6 Places That Open Early (2026)
item.description: Where to eat breakfast in Krakow from 7:00: six independent spots with exact opening hours, prices and what to order, from Kleparz by the station to Kazimierz.

item.description: The best brunch in Krakow: crepes in Kazimierz, eggs benedict in Krowodrza, a French bakery, vegan plates and a riverside view. Prices included.

item.description: Cheap eats in Krakow under 30 zl: milk bars, hand-folded pierogi, the best kebab in town, halal Indian from 16 zl and banh mi under 25.

item.description: Eating at the Krakow Christmas Market 2026 on the Main Square: dates, hours and what to eat, from mulled wine and oscypek to pierogi. Halal tips.

item.title: Best Cocktail Bars in Krakow: 6 Rooms Worth Dressing For
item.description: The best cocktail bars in Krakow: a cocktail-and-music bar off the Planty, two speakeasies, an Old Town classic and drinks in a former synagogue.

item.title: Good Coffee Near Krakow Main Station (2 Real Cafes, Not Chains)
item.description: Good coffee near Krakow main station: two independent cafes within ten minutes of Kraków Główny, with walking times, hours and what to order.

item.title: A Perfect Day in Kleparz, Krakow: Morning to Evening Itinerary (2026)
item.description: A one-day walk through Kleparz, Krakow's oldest market district: coffee at Bruk, the Stary Kleparz market, the Barbican, lunch and evening drinks.

item.title: Dog-Friendly Cafes in Krakow: 5 Places That Mean It (2026)
item.description: Five genuinely dog-friendly cafes in Krakow, water bowls and treats confirmed: Bruk Cafe by the station, Lokator, Cafe Pianola, Czyżyk and Wesoła Cafe.

item.title: Best Georgian Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Khachapuri, Khinkali and Wine
item.description: The best Georgian restaurants in Krakow: adjaruli khachapuri at Tbilisuri, khinkali by the river, a home-style kitchen and Georgian wine.

item.title: Halal Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Certified Kitchens and What to Order
item.description: Halal food in Krakow: certified halal Indian, a Syrian charcoal kebab grill, tandoor spots and vegetarian kitchens. Also in Polish, Arabic and Chinese.

item.title: Best Family-Run Ice Cream in Krakow (No Chains, 2026)
item.description: Four family-run ice cream shops in Krakow: the Starowiślna window open since 1985, a 1917 recipe and Nowa Huta's one-flavour-a-day classics.

item.title: Best Indian Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Curry, Tandoor, Dosa and Vegan
item.description: The best Indian food in Krakow: the top-rated North Indian, the only real South Indian dosa kitchen, the best butter chicken and a vegan room.

item.title: Best Italian Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Pizza, Pasta and Where Locals Go
item.description: The best Italian food in Krakow: the Neapolitan pizza that started the wave, truffle pasta on the prettiest street and seafood off the Main Square.

item.title: Kazimierz Coffee and Brunch Guide: The Good Places Between the Crowds
item.description: Cafes and brunch in Kazimierz, Krakow: the best matcha and coffee at Café Belmont, cafes in former prayer houses and where to sit when plac Nowy overflows.

item.description: The best kebab in Krakow: the Syrian charcoal grill locals rate highest, a 4.8-star doner, tandoor flatbread, hummus and Israeli mezze.

item.title: Kleparz Food and Coffee Guide: Where Locals Eat Near Krakow's Oldest Market
item.description: Where to eat in Kleparz, Krakow: the Stary Kleparz market, specialty coffee at Bruk Cafe five minutes from the station and BiBułka's Dubai chocolate.

item.title: Best Korean Food in Krakow (2026): Bibimbap, Fried Chicken and K-Hot Pot
item.description: The best Korean food in Krakow: a Michelin-listed Korean-Japanese kitchen, chef Park's bibimbap, the top-rated kimbap and Korean fried chicken.

item.title: Krakow for Digital Nomads: Cafes, Coworking and Costs in 2026
item.description: Working remotely from Krakow: laptop-friendly cafes, coworking day passes, monthly costs, internet speeds, visa rules and where to live.

item.title: Krowodrza Food Guide: 6 Places Beyond the Old Town Wall in Krakow
item.description: Eating in Krowodrza and Kleparz, Krakow: a family roastery, the city's best artisan bakery, brunch on Plac Inwalidów and a restobar in a 19th-century fort.

item.title: Matcha in Krakow: Where to Drink It in Kazimierz
item.description: Where to drink matcha in Krakow: Café Belmont in Kazimierz with Yume Matcha, the Ayko matcha bar in Podgórze and Boby in Dębniki. Hours and prices.

item.title: Art & Food Bazar at Stary Kleparz: Sunday Dates, Hours and How to Plan It
item.description: Art & Food Bazar at Stary Kleparz: free Sunday food fair on 18 Oct, 15 Nov and 6 Dec 2026, 11:00 to 17:00. What to expect and where to eat before and after.

item.title: COPPA: A Specialty Coffee and Tiramisu Bar Opens on Mazowiecka
item.description: COPPA, a specialty coffee bar built around tiramisu, has opened at Mazowiecka 60 in Krowodrza, Krakow: serious coffee and tiramisu made daily.

item.title: BNP Paribas Green Film Festival 2026: What to Eat by the River
item.description: What to eat at the Green Film Festival in Krakow: the eco food zone on the Vistula boulevards, river restaurants near Wawel and other August events.

item.title: Mlaskoty Food Festival at Plac Na Stawach: Sunday 25 October 2026
item.description: Mlaskoty, Krakow's local food festival, returns to Plac Na Stawach on Sunday 25 October 2026, 11:00 to 17:00, free entry. What to expect and where to eat.

item.title: 9 New Restaurants and Cafes in Krakow, Summer 2026
item.description: What opened in Krakow in summer 2026: a Swedish table in Kazimierz, Balkan pasta from the NORMA team, matcha cocktails in Krowodrza, Berlin kebab and five more.

item.title: Słońce: A New Polish Restaurant Just Opened on św. Tomasza
item.description: Słońce, a modern Polish restaurant, has opened at ul. św. Tomasza 4 in Krakow's Old Town: hand-made pierogi in open view and a six-hour broth.

item.title: 6 Best Outdoor Cafes in Krakow: Gardens, Terraces and Courtyards
item.description: Outdoor dining in Krakow: hidden Art Nouveau gardens, Kazimierz courtyards, a Vistula riverside terrace and the city's biggest beer garden.

item.title: Best Pierogi in Krakow (2026): Where Poles Actually Eat Polish Food
item.description: The best pierogi in Krakow: an 80-year-old canteen, a milk bar on the Royal Route, dumplings folded in open view and Poland's two-Michelin-star kitchen.

item.title: Podgorze Food Guide: 6 Reasons to Cross the River in Krakow
item.description: Eating in Podgórze, Krakow: Michelin-recommended tapas near Schindler's Factory, the cafe with the best view, French pastry and jazz on the river.
